description: Aires de stationnement is a dataset listed in Gpseo open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by GPS&O. Aires de stationnement présentes sur le territoire, validées par la Commission Locale d'Evaluation des Transferts de Charge. Les données comprennent notamment le nombre de places disponibles et la surface en m². Coverage: Grand Paris Seine et Oise. The portal files it under Transport, Movements. Its keywords are mobilité, stationnement. The portal shows 261 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open License Version 2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-gpseo-portal.
